kind: Independent formal-scope comparison of original trilingual blind readbacks against captured compiler signatures, plus compiler-graph producer consumption audit

method.authority: Compiler elaboratedType is used for actual declaration scope, including retained implicit typeclasses. Source text is used only to expand local definitions and interpret binder meanings.
checked: Existential/universal quantifier order and permitted dependence
All embeddings over the same full point fields
Shared subsequence and finite set versus function-dependent constants/tails
method.normalization_check: All 62 normalized statements dictionaries equal their corresponding original packets byte for byte at JSON string level. No blind readback text was rewritten.
method.language_provenance: Three languages are texts from each original reader, not three independent audits. This audit independently compared all three against compiler scope.
not_defects: Equivalent reordering of independent universal data or hypotheses
Strict versus non-strict eventual exceedance of every real threshold for tending to atTop
Omission of universe variable names or Lean implicit/explicit argument notation when arbitrary mathematical scope is preserved

findings.compiler_elaborated_type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] [Countable K] {E : Type u_2} [inst_3 : NormedField E] {Good : E → Prop},
  (∀ (a : ℕ → E),
      (∀ (n : ℕ), Good (a n)) →
        ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ),
          StrictMono φ ∧
            ((∃ (b : E), Filter.Tendsto (a ∘ φ) Filter.atTop (nhds b)) ∨
              Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => ‖a (φ n)‖) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)) →
    ∀ {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (y : ℕ → Fin d → AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Source.Local.EPlace K E),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (f : K) (α : E), (y n i).val f = Option.some α → Good α) →
        ∀ (D₀ : ℕ → ℕ),
          StrictMono D₀ →
            ∃ (D : ℕ → ℕ),
              StrictMono D ∧
                (∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono ψ ∧ D = D₀ ∘ ψ) ∧
                  ∃ (ξ : Fin d → K → Option E),
                    ∀ (i : Fin d) (f : K),
                      AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Source.Local.TendstoP1 (fun (n : ℕ) => (y (D n) i).val f)
                        (ξ i f)

en: For a field $K$ and a normed field $E$

findings.explanation: The actual compiler type requires characteristic zero on K in addition to Field K and Countable K. Each readback states an arbitrary countable field and gives no characteristic-zero qualification. The source theorem inherits the unused ambient section class [CharZero K]; ignoring proof use does not remove the actual binder.
findings.metadata_also_affected: The original packet static_context.parameters_and_names for this declaration lists Field K and Countable K but omits CharZero K.
findings.impact: Each language readback describes a more general scope than this elaborated theorem. The proof and final localCompactness statement are not invalidated; this is an exact readback defect.
findings.required_correction_scope: A subsequent reviewed correction must include characteristic zero for K in all three language renderings and formal parameter metadata, while preserving these original blind packets. This audit does not provide replacement blind text.
